description: This file defines a tool for executing HTTP PUT requests, including schema creation based on dynamic JSON input, and a class extending a dynamic tool to perform the request with error handling.

classes.name: RequestsPutTool
classes.description: A class extending DynamicStructuredTool to perform configurable HTTP PUT requests with dynamic schema support.

methods.name: createRequestsPutSchema
methods.description: Creates a Zod schema for the PUT request body based on an optional JSON schema string.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Performs the PUT request using secureFetch, handling headers, body, and errors, and returns the response text truncated to maxOutputLength.
